name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Beatrix and Edmund, one goes with Cooper and the other with 10 coins.

Southgate goes with either Edmund or Fletcher (but not both).
Beatrix goes with neither Blacksmith nor Cooper.
Kingsford goes with exactly two of Edmund, Cooper, and 8 coins.
If Blacksmith goes with 9 coins, then 10 coins does not go with Potter.
Either Oldwall goes with 10 coins or Potter goes with Kingsford.
